data.narrative:
Ouros Energy is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Ethan Loosbrock that has raised $3M or more to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the narrow peer set at seed stage or adjacent stages with similar valuation tiers yielded insufficient datapoints for reliable peer-median triangulation.

Given data constraints, the Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using the $3M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $8M ($7.5M post-rounding). This methodology reflects typical venture progression patterns, though relies on the assumption that total capital raised approximates current valuation—a reasonable proxy for early-stage companies but subject to dilution and fair-value dynamics.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, centered at $8M. The valuation rests on a single triangulation method and reflects stage-appropriate leverage of the $3M raised figure. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer-stage comparables to validate market pricing, the timing and composition of the $3M raise relative to current market conditions, and undisclosed metrics regarding burn rate, product maturity, or traction that would typically inform seed-stage risk adjustment.
